summary: Iter42 — Multi-point (waypoint) editing for ALL lines (aerial + underground) on Job Map. Backend bulk-routes API verified (6/6 pytest pass). UI: EditableRoute now renders midpoint dots on BOTH aerial and UG dashed segments; clicking midpoint adds a route-waypoint; Save persists via /jobs/{id}/routes/bulk; after reload waypoints are still present and lines bend through them (visual verified). CRITICAL BUG FOUND & FIXED by tester: JobMap.jsx had a Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) reference error — saveRouteEdits useCallback referenced orderedSegments before its declaration, so the entire /jobs/{id}/map page threw 'Cannot access orderedSegments before initialization' and did not render. Fixed by deferring the body via a useRef + effect. REMAINING BUG (not fixed): segListDistance at JobMap.jsx line 1140 still filters waypoints by seg.isAerial (const wps = seg.isAerial ? ... : []), so UG segment waypoints are NOT reflected in the span-measurements list or underground total. Confirmed empirically: after seeding a bent UG waypoint via /routes/bulk, the map visually shows the UG line bending through the waypoint, but the span list still shows straight-line 365 ft instead of the longer bent-path distance (aerial waypoint DID update from 365 ft → 1,313 ft as expected).

ui_bugs.issue: Only uses waypoints for aerial segments (const wps = seg.isAerial ? (customRoutes[key] || []) : []). UG segment waypoints are ignored so span list distance & underground total do NOT follow bent UG paths. Repro: seed a bent waypoint for a UG segment via /jobs/{id}/routes/bulk, open map — line visually bends but list shows straight-line distance. Fix: remove the isAerial filter so all segments include waypoints (const wps = customRoutes[key] || []).

action_items: Fix JobMap.jsx line 1140 segListDistance: drop the seg.isAerial gate so UG waypoints extend the span-list distance and underground total (const wps = customRoutes[`${seg.from.id}-${seg.to.id}`] || []).

Review the TDZ fix I applied at JobMap.jsx (saveRouteEditsRef + useEffect binding after orderedSegments) — consider simply moving the entire saveRouteEdits useCallback declaration to below orderedSegments for cleaner code.
critical_code_review_comments: JobMap.jsx TDZ bug: saveRouteEdits useCallback at ~line 521 depended on orderedSegments (declared at ~line 1018) — caused ReferenceError blocking the entire /jobs/{id}/map page. Tester applied a useRef indirection fix; recommend the main agent move the useCallback below orderedSegments for a cleaner solution.

JobMap.jsx segListDistance (line 1140) filters waypoints by seg.isAerial — remaining unfixed. This is the direct cause of UG span list distances not following waypoints. All other layers (EditableRoute rendering, saveRouteEdits, /routes/bulk backend, buildSpanMeasurementTexts, downloadPoleMapImage in poleMapImage.js) already handle UG waypoints correctly via segPath(pr, routes).

poleMapImage.js already uses segPath/pathFeet/pathMid on all segments regardless of aerial/UG, so exhibit downloads and ASE buildSpanMeasurementTexts will follow UG waypoints correctly (verified by reading source; exhibit PNG generation not automated in this run).
Backend /jobs/{id}/routes/bulk correctly accepts generic ids (underground handhole id as to_pole_id) and persists them (6/6 backend tests pass, including GET verification).

rca_of_the_issue: TWO defects found: (A) TDZ: saveRouteEdits at line 521 in a useCallback with orderedSegments (line 1018) in its dependency array. React evaluates the closure body top-down during render; hitting orderedSegments before its `const` initialization threw ReferenceError, preventing the map page from ever rendering. Fixed by tester via useRef-indirection so the closure captures the ref, and the real implementation is assigned in a useEffect below orderedSegments. (B) UG list-distance regression: segListDistance line 1140 gates waypoints behind seg.isAerial, so only aerial segments use waypoint path length. UG segments always report straight-line distance regardless of persisted route waypoints. Fix: remove the ternary and always look up customRoutes[`${seg.from.id}-${seg.to.id}`].
